name: First five

sprites.name: Arceus
sprites.note: All 1,008 frames match the old file, and every type's look at sample ticks. The gold is metal. The wheel's gems glow, the eyes faintly.

sprites.name: Bulbasaur
sprites.note: Back: the bulb's leaf edges now count as drawn lines, so each leaf catches the light as its own leaf. Before, the whole bulb shaded as one ball. The bulb is close to matte now; it was a little glossy and see-through. The art is unchanged.

sprites.name: Jellicent
sprites.note: The white mustache and frills (pink on the female) are soft and dull now. They were set a little glossy and half see-through, which gave the wet shine. Checked against the library's material notes (only the body and crown are wet jelly) and the games' Pokédex text (the body is mostly seawater; nothing calls the collar shiny). The blue body is still glossy jelly. The art is unchanged.

sprites.name: Christmas Corsoreef
sprites.note: Back: the tree is now the front's own tree (fine tinsel, small lights) in every pose, normal and shiny, so the two sides match. It is the front's drawing, not flipped, so its painted light still comes from the upper left. The rest of the back is as it was.

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Redone from scratch on the official Gen 5 Charizard: its parts, pose, size and motion, front and back, repainted. Charcoal hide, a ribcage belly with ghost fire between the ribs, a plated tail underside, a purple ghost flame, and a faint see-through film of ghost fire between the wing bones. Shiny is Insurgence's dark red with orange fire. It keeps Charizard's two horns and build. Say if it should take more from the Insurgence drawing (one swept horn, a skull face, bare wing bones).

note: Fifth look. The four you marked are redone: Bulbasaur's bulb, Jellicent's mustache, Corsoreef's back tree, and Delta Charizard from scratch on Charizard. Arceus is unchanged.
